0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home, 1-0 on the road) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home) in the Magic's fourth game of the season, with Orlando sitting 10th in the East and one game back of the division lead while Toronto is 4th in the East and riding a one-game losing streak. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series Orlando lost 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
